summary: Replay review found two legitimate answers reported as failures. A member whose only account is checking, and a closed member with no accounts, both ran out the full step timeout and failed with target_not_found, which with escalation enabled would page a person. Neither is a fault: there is simply no savings balance to return, and the caller needs to know which case applies.

addOutcomes.description: The member has no open accounts at all, so there is no savings balance to return.
The member's accounts are showing, but none of them is a savings account, so there is no savings balance to return.
